_README: Field definitions for the NHL 2k10 Roster.ROS TEAM record (chunk 0x8489FAF3, stride 412).
RENAME a field by editing its 'name' here, then hit 'Reload defs' in the Team Fields editor.
Names must be unique. 'note' is free text shown as the column tooltip — record what you learned.
type: u8 | u16 | u32 | i8 | i16 | i32 | f32 | rgb (3 bytes -> #RRGGBB) | hex (raw bytes).
off is relative to the START of a team record. Only bytes that VARY across the 30 teams are
listed (the other 207 are always-zero or identical everywhere, so nothing to edit).
